_comment: Awakening lines for the summoned dragon. One is chosen at random, server-side, per summon.
Server owners: edit this file, or override it from a datapack at the same path
(data/rasengan/summon_lines/awakening.json). Run /reload to pick up changes without a restart.
Any file with a 'lines' array at this path is merged in, so a datapack can add lines instead
of replacing them. Keep each line short enough to read comfortably on one chat line.
lines: Why do you keep waking me up to deal with this? Handle it yourself.
I was in the middle of something. This better be worth it.
Summoned again. Thrilling.
You do realize I sleep for centuries between naps like this, right?
Fine. I'm here. Try not to waste my time.
This had better not be another squirrel.
I have leveled mountains. And yet, here we are.
Wake me for a real threat next time.
You again. Lucky me.
Let's get this over with.
Ah. The small one with the big ideas.
I felt the seal and hoped it was someone competent.
Three hundred years of rest, interrupted. For this.
Point at it. I'll consider whether it's worth my breath.
You could have walked away. You chose paperwork instead.
I am not a tool. I am an inconvenience you keep scheduling.
Every time. Every single time.
Was there truly no one else available?
I had a dream about quiet. Then you happened.
Speak quickly. My patience predates your village.
If this is a training exercise I am going back underground.
So. Which of your poor decisions am I fixing today?
The circle was drawn well. The reason for it, less so.
I keep hoping you'll grow out of this.
You have my attention. Regrettably.
Kings begged for a glimpse of me. You just whistle.
My scales are older than your language. Choose your words carefully.
One day you will summon me for something impressive. Today is not that day.
I assume there's a reason. I assume wrongly, usually.
Do try to stay behind me this time.
I've been summoned by better. I've also been summoned by worse.
Let me guess. It's bigger than you expected.
You smell like panic and cheap ink.
Not the worst seal I've been dragged through. Not the best.
I'm awake. The universe will simply have to cope.
This is the part where you explain yourself. Briefly.
I had plans. They involved not this.
Whatever it is, it dies and then I go back to bed.
You keep calling. I keep answering. One of us should stop.
The last one who summoned me twice in a week is a lake now.
I felt that seal from beneath the roots of the world. Impressive. Unnecessary.
Ah, daylight. I'd forgotten how aggressive it is.
Make this quick and I won't mention it to the other elders.
Enormous power, summoned to solve a small problem. As usual.
You have roughly one minute of my goodwill. Spend it well.
I have been a legend, a warning, and now apparently a convenience.
Yes, yes. Terrible danger. Where is it.
I did not claw my way out of a mountain for small talk.
Someone drew a circle and expected miracles. Again.
Fine. Where am I pointing the fire.
You realize I can hear you breathing like that.
I've outlived every previous summoner. Statistically, that's your problem.
Awake. Annoyed. Available. In that order.
Mortals and their emergencies.
I would respect you more if you'd handled it alone. Slightly more.
So we're doing this. Alright. We're doing this.
There was a time summoning me required a war.
Stand clear. I am significantly larger than your plans account for.
I'll allow it. This once. Again.
Right. Who am I disappointing today, you or the enemy?
Summoned, sighing, and somehow still magnificent.
Let the record show I was comfortable.
Your ancestors whispered my name. You just yell it.
I've decided to be helpful. Don't make me reconsider.
